subject: SOC 2 Type II onboarding: initial evidence snapshot & ownership matrix
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@acme-corp.com>, Timothy Shaw <t.shaw@bluewaveops.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 Type II onboarding: initial evidence snapshot & ownership matrix

Hi Laura / Tim,

Thanks for the intro. We're kicking off a Type II evidence intake for Acme Analytics to support your integration review. To make this low friction, could you please: 

- Confirm the report period you need (e.g., 2025-09-01 — 2026-08-31 or a different 12-month window).
- Share whether you need a bridge letter to cover the gap between our most recent report and your procurement window.
- Provide a primary contact for uploads or confirm if we should send presigned upload instructions to your security mailbox.

I've attached a short intake checklist that prioritizes the minimum artifacts we typically share (control narratives, policy snapshots, sample logs, and evidence of key admin processes). Also attaching an ownership-matrix template — if you could fill the ‘acme_owner’ column for each artifact that will help speed handoff.

Attachments: soc2-intake-checklist.xlsx

Proposed next step: if you're comfortable, reply with the audit period and preferred transfer method; otherwise we can schedule a 30-min intake call.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Technical Program Manager — Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
pri yom.das@redwoodinference.com

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@acme-corp.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Timothy Shaw <t.shaw@bluewaveops.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II onboarding: initial evidence snapshot & ownership matrix

Hi Priyom — thanks. Quick answers from our side: 

- Audit period: we prefer 2025-10-01 through 2026-09-30 (aligns with our vendor review).
- Bridge letter: our procurement team may request one if the report date doesn't overlap our contract start; please let us know the report date once available.
- Upload: please send presigned upload instructions to security@acme-corp.com and I will loop in our asset owner to confirm receipt.

One question on the ownership matrix: would you like us to indicate both a primary and backup owner? We can do that if it helps you route follow-ups.

I'll assign our evidence intake lead, Tim (cc'd), to work with you.

Best,
Laura Chen
Sr. IT Risk Manager | Acme Analytics
Attachments: none

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@acme-corp.com>, Timothy Shaw <t.shaw@bluewaveops.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II onboarding: initial evidence snapshot & ownership matrix

Laura — perfect, thanks for the period. For clarity and to minimize back-and-forth, attached is a prioritized snapshot (tab A in the intake checklist):

Priority A (deliver within 5 business days):
- Control narratives for Access Control, Change Management, and Logging & Monitoring (sample policies + latest revision dates).
- Admin user list exports and recent MFA enforcement screenshots.
- One month of ingest + processing telemetry (anonymized examples OK) and an example retention config.

Priority B (if available within 10 business days):
- Redaction guidance for telemetry samples and high-level architecture diagram.
- Evidence of vulnerability scanning cadence.

I've uploaded the ownership-matrix-template.csv and a short one-line reply template to the shared Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2Bintake-pack-soc2.

Presigned upload instructions are attached (presigned-instructions.txt). Please have your intake lead reply with primary (and optionally backup) owners for the Priority A artifacts. If your team prefers, you can also reply to this thread with the files directly or we can accept a DocuSign agreement for transfer if needed.

Attachments: ownership-matrix-template.csv; presigned-instructions.txt

One more note on bridge letters: our latest Type II covers through 2026-06-30 — if your period ends 2026-09-30 we'll provide bridge options (short cover letter vs. attestation note). We can confirm wording after your procurement team advises.

Thanks — looking forward to the owners list so Ben (intake) can route artifacts to the correct storage buckets.

— Priyom

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
